snippet.title: Tetris + Minesweeper (UPDATED)
snippet.description:
Tetris + Minesweeper! This game has gotten many updates since I last played the game, including a whole new UI, score multiplier Tetrissweep and T-Spin Sweeps (you get these by doing the respective Tetris move but also clearing the whole minesweeper row before the next piece drops), revealed-piece rewards, new safe zones and level that increase over time, holding, just really making this a great Tetris experience as well.



game link: https://kertisjones.itch.io/tetrisweeper
Tetrisweeper discord: https://discord.gg/SWKRhnvNnd
my own personal discord: https://discord.gg/V64JDvbWsf


The only complaints I have now are that chording feels really inconsistent and it's almost not worth doing. Also, since I'm not very good at the game, my runs are all ending due to misclicks instead of topping out, which I think is less satisfying. A mode where junk lines happen instead of immediately losing would appeal to me.

Anyway the design and talk of future gamemodes and stuff is very exciting for this game :)


video ends when I lose... kind of


video at the end: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HHY43_hnaSo
